definition_zh: 通过可见外观观察评估结构缺陷的检查方式。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

usage_variants.context_label: 监测与数字化 · Digital Railway Infrastructure（2024）

complete_examples.text: Graybeal et al. [1] have suggested that, at most, 81% of condition ratings carried out through visual inspection were done accurately, due to limitations such as inspectors’ concerns about traffic, their eyesight, accessibility of the structure, and complexity of the assessment.

By converting the images into a photorealistic 3D model of the structure, inspectors can perform a visual inspection of it on a computer, without incurring the risks and time constraints that arise in the field environment.
